description: On-device verification of the finished redesign with screenshots, per plan.md section 10. Required device id is 10BF3A1CM30013Z. It was not connected at planning time (only emulator-5554 was), so follow the fallback rule: retry connecting once, otherwise use the one connected Android device and state plainly in verification.md which device was really used. Fix any defects found (small UI fixes in presentation/theme only) and re-run the gates. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Read plan.md section 10. Run `adb devices -l` and `flutter devices`; if 10BF3A1CM30013Z is missing run `adb reconnect offline; adb wait-for-device` with a 30 s timeout, then fall back to the connected Android device. Record the choice.

mkdir -p /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/screenshots. Build and install: `flutter build apk --debug` then `adb -s <id> install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk` and launch the main activity (read the applicationId from android/app/build.gradle*). Reset any leftover adb state first (font_scale 1.0, wm size reset, wm density reset, animator scales 1.0).

Walk the whole checklist in plan.md section 10 (items 1 to 14): bootstrap loader/error, Today empty, Add blank/errors/keyboard, Today with >= 4 habits (long name, some done, streaks), toasts '+N points' and '-N points', Detail open/done, delete confirmation (swipe), error snackbar if reproducible, 2.0x font + 320dp-wide layouts of Today/Detail/Add, reduced-motion run. Save every screenshot as /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/screenshots/<NN>-<name>.png via `adb -s <id> exec-out screencap -p`. View each PNG with the image reader and write down defects.

Fix defects found in presentation/theme code (never in data/domain/auth/bloc), re-run `dart format .`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, rebuild, re-shoot affected screenshots. ALWAYS restore device settings (font_scale 1.0, wm size reset, wm density reset, animation scales 1.0) even if a step fails.

Write /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/.agents/tasks/verification.md: device actually used (and the plain statement if it was not 10BF3A1CM30013Z), commands run with exit codes, the screenshot list with one-line findings each, defects found and fixed, what could not be verified (for example midnight resume, anything the device could not reproduce) and why, final `flutter test` count, `flutter analyze` result.
Final gate list from plan.md section 11 (format, analyze, tests, architecture test, leftover grep, git status scoped to the project showing no changes in forbidden folders, no commits).
acceptance_criteria: The app was built, installed and launched on a real connected Android device or emulator, and verification.md says exactly which one.

screenshots/ contains the checklist PNGs (at least Today empty, Today with habits, toast +, toast -, Detail open and done, Add blank and errors, delete dialog, and the 2.0x/320dp captures of Today, Detail and Add) and each was inspected.
No overflow stripes, clipped text, unreadable contrast, filled buttons, pills (except the toast) or purple/blue tints appear in any screenshot.
Device settings (font scale, wm size/density, animation scales) are restored.
verification.md exists with commands, findings, deviations and unverifiable items; flutter analyze and flutter test are green after any fixes.
verification: cd /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment && flutter analyze && flutter test 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment && adb shell settings get system font_scale && adb shell wm size
findings: Done on the REQUIRED device 10BF3A1CM30013Z (vivo I2221, Android 16), over USB. It was invisible to adb in the sandbox until ADB_LIBUSB=1 was set. Build workarounds (no project change): symlink SDK copy /tmp/fsdk with writable flutter_tools/gradle, Gradle copy in /tmp/gh + GRADLE_RO_DEP_CACHE, JDK17 via flutter config --jdk-dir (in sandbox HOME), ANDROID_USER_HOME=/Users/macbook/.android to keep the real debug keystore (otherwise INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE; nothing uninstalled). android/local.properties restored. 18 screenshots in screenshots/ (01 skeleton, 02 today, 03/04/05 add blank/errors/keyboard, 06 today with 6 habits, 07/08 toasts +10/-10, 09/10 detail open/done, 11 delete dialog, 12 after delete, 13/13b today, 14/14b detail, 15/15b add at 2.0x on 320dp), each viewed; no overflow, filled buttons, pills (other than toast) or purple/blue tints. Defects fixed: (1) validation text ellipsized at 2x/320dp -> errorMaxLines/helperMaxLines 3 in app_theme.dart + test; (2) 8 Detail tests overflowed (7.8px at 1.5x, 97px at 2x) because of an already-present BaselineSplit refactor in the tree (baseline_split.dart, day_chip, progress_header, app_tokens, habit_detail_page, edited 00:32-00:33, not by this step) -> 'day streak' unit wrapped in Flexible in habit_detail_page.dart. Gates: dart format clean, flutter analyze no issues, flutter test 394 passed, architecture test 6 passed, leftover grep clean in lib/pubspec, no commit. Follow-up on EMULATOR emulator-5554 (NOT the required device; user started it after the phone disconnected): empty Today state, and a reduced-motion run (all three animation scales 0): saving spinner, toast and Detail appear instantly, no crash. Screenshots suffixed -EMULATOR (02b, 01b native splash only, 16a-16c). Emulator test habit deleted, scales restored to 1.0. Also on emulator: bootstrap error screen verified (01c: OFFLINE kicker, real message, Retry recovers after reconnecting). Error snackbar NOT reproducible (offline toggles succeed from the Firestore cache; test-covered only). Emulator left clean: empty Today, scales 1.0, airplane off. NOT verified: TalkBack, midnight resume (test-covered); error snackbar skipped on user instruction (test-covered). Device settings restored: font_scale 1.0, wm size 1080x2400 (pre-existing override, NOT reset), density reset, animation scales 1.0. PHONE RECONNECTED LATER: the app had been uninstalled, so the old anonymous user (with QA_Read, QA_Meditate, QA_A_very_long_habit_name..., plus the user's own Divyansh and Drink) is orphaned in Firestore and unreachable from the app; delete via Firebase console if wanted. Reinstalled the latest build on the phone (new anonymous account) and captured the in-app bootstrap loader (01-bootstrap-loader-phone) and the empty Today state (02-today-empty-phone) on the PHYSICAL device. No test data left on the new account. Pre-existing habits Divyansh and Drink were not touched. Details in .agents/tasks/verification.md. CLOSING: last green gates (before concurrent edits) = format clean/140 files, analyze clean, 394 tests, architecture 6. At 02:49-02:52 someone else added an in-progress splash/brand-mark feature (lib/core/brand.dart, brand_mark.dart, splash_view.dart, app.dart, app_test.dart, brand_mark_test.dart) which currently makes analyze report 3 issues and 12 tests fail (11 in app_test.dart plus brand_mark_test.dart load error). Not touched by this step; needs its owner to finish.
